Enabled.Name: Prevent double animations
Enabled.Hint: When Automated Animations and Boss Loot FX would both animate an item, effect or condition, only the one chosen under Priority plays.

Priority.Name: Priority
Priority.Hint: Which module plays when both would animate the same thing. The other one still animates everything the chosen module doesn't.

Overrides.Name: Priority by name
Overrides.Hint: Pick the module that plays for specific items, effects or conditions, overriding Priority for them.
Overrides.Label: Edit list

MatchMode.Name: What counts as a duplicate
MatchMode.Hint: Same activity: the other module is skipped if the module with priority animates the activity at any moment (attack, damage, use, template, summon). In this mode an effect counts as part of the activity that applies it (for example Witch Bolt's lingering lightning). Same moment only: the other module is skipped only if both would animate the exact same moment, so the other module's damage animation still plays when the module with priority only animates the attack, and effects are only compared with effects. Conditions are always compared with each other only.

Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Write every skipped and allowed animation to the browser console.

Overrides.Title: Priority by name
Overrides.Intro: Each entry picks the module that plays for one item, effect or condition, instead of {global} (set under Priority). Enter its name ("Witch Bolt") or its identifier ("witch-bolt"); case, spaces and hyphens don't matter. For effects and conditions, the effect's name, its status ("poisoned") or the item it comes from all match.
